This project is called LOGOS: "The Word Made Flesh" A Narrated Word-for-Word Version of the Bible in a movie. This FIRST EVER groundbreaking film will follow the Scriptures word-for-word, bringing the Word of God to life like never before.

We are working on a trailer for Logos to submit to the world’s largest AI film festival at "Project Odyssey". This trailer is key to showcasing the project’s vision and getting it in front of a global audience. I’m also collaborating with YouTubers to help spread the word and share this dream with as many people as possible.

Laura Williams & Ryan Day donated the song "Ancient Words" to be used in it.

Where Your Donations Will Go:

AI Subscriptions: Access cutting-edge AI tools for video production, animation, audio, and visual effects.
Website Creation: To build a hub where people can learn more about Logos, access resources, and stay updated on the project.


Any extra funds will go toward establishing a nonprofit to ensure the sustainability and outreach of Logos.
AI film school to improve our skills and continue innovating with this project.

Your support will help me bring Logos to life in this film competition, it's more than just a film—it’s a tool for engaging the world with the Word of God in a new and exciting way.

Thank you for supporting me and participating with us in this incredible journey!
